{"check":"from slugify import slugify
from slugify.__main__ import parse_args, slugify_params
import io, sys

def test_regex_forwarded_none():
    params = slugify_params(parse_args(['slugify', 'Hello_42']))
    assert params['regex_pattern'] is None
    assert slugify(**params) == 'hello-42'

def test_regex_forwarded_custom():
    pattern = r'[^a-z_]+'
    params = slugify_params(parse_args(['slugify', 'Hello_42', '--regex-pattern', pattern]))
    assert params['regex_pattern'] == pattern
    assert slugify(**params) == 'hello_'

def test_other_options_preserved():
    params = slugify_params(parse_args(['slugify', 'A B', '--separator', '_', '--no-lowercase', '--max-length', '5']))
    assert params['separator'] == '_'
    assert params['lowercase'] is False
    assert params['max_length'] == 5
    assert params['regex_pattern'] is None
    assert slugify(**params) == 'A_B'

def test_stdin_input():
    old = sys.stdin
    sys.stdin = io.StringIO('Hi there')
    try:
        params = slugify_params(parse_args(['slugify', '--stdin']))
    finally:
        sys.stdin = old
    assert params['text'] == 'Hi there'
    assert slugify(**params) == 'hi-there'

def test_iterable_options_still_work():
    reps = iter([('|', 'or'), iter(['%', 'percent'])])
    out = slugify('a|b% c', replacements=reps)
    assert out == 'a-or-bpercent-c'
    sw = iter(['the'])
    assert slugify('the quick the fox', stopwords=sw) == 'quick-fox'
    sw2 = iter(['The'])
    assert slugify('The quick The fox', stopwords=sw2, lowercase=False) == 'quick-fox'

def test_none_empty_preserved():
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=None, stopwords=None) == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=(), stopwords=()) == 'a-b'"}
